translations.chinese: 漢興，接秦之獘，丈夫從軍旅，老弱轉糧馕，作業劇而財匱，自天子不能具鈞駟，而將相或乘牛車，齊民無藏蓋。
translations.literal: Han rose, connected Qin exhaustion, men followed military campaigns, old weak transported grain food, work intense and wealth scarce, from Son of Heaven could not equip matched horses, and generals ministers or rode ox carts, common people no stored covers.
translations.idiomatic: When Han rose, it inherited Qin’s exhaustion. Men followed military campaigns, the old and infirm transported grain and food, labor was heavy and wealth scarce, and even the Son of Heaven could not equip matched horses, while generals and ministers sometimes rode ox carts and commoners had nothing in reserve.

context.next: 於是為秦錢重難用，更令民鑄錢，一黃金一斤，約法省禁。

translations.chinese: 於是為秦錢重難用，更令民鑄錢，一黃金一斤，約法省禁。
translations.literal: Therefore because Qin money heavy difficult use, moreover ordered people cast money, one yellow gold one jin, regulated laws reduced prohibitions.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore, because Qin coinage was heavy and hard to use, they further ordered the people to cast money, one jin of yellow gold, and regulated the laws while reducing prohibitions.

context.previous: 漢興，接秦之獘，丈夫從軍旅，老弱轉糧馕，作業劇而財匱，自天子不能具鈞駟，而將相或乘牛車，齊民無藏蓋。
context.next: 而不軌逐利之民，蓄積餘業以稽市物，物踴騰糶，米至石萬錢，馬一匹則百金。

translations.chinese: 而不軌逐利之民，蓄積餘業以稽市物，物踴騰糶，米至石萬錢，馬一匹則百金。
translations.literal: And not following tracks pursuing profit people, accumulated surplus business to delay market goods, goods leaped soared sold, rice to shi ten thousand cash, horse one then hundred gold.
translations.idiomatic: People who did not follow the rules and pursued profit accumulated surplus stock to delay the market, driving goods up in price. Rice reached ten thousand cash per shi, and a single horse cost a hundred gold.

context.previous: 於是為秦錢重難用，更令民鑄錢，一黃金一斤，約法省禁。

translations.chinese: 天下已平，高祖乃令賈人不得衣絲乘車，重租稅以困辱之。
translations.literal: World already pacified, Gao Zu then ordered merchants not wear silk ride carriages, heavy taxes to distress humiliate them.
translations.idiomatic: After the realm was pacified, Emperor Gaozu then ordered that merchants could not wear silk or ride carriages and imposed heavy taxes to disgrace them.

context.next: 孝惠、高后時，為天下初定，復弛商賈之律，然市井之子孫亦不得仕宦為吏。

translations.chinese: 孝惠、高后時，為天下初定，復弛商賈之律，然市井之子孫亦不得仕宦為吏。
translations.literal: Xiao Hui, Gao Hou time, because world initially settled, again relaxed merchant laws, yet marketplace sons grandsons also not allowed serve as officials be clerks.
translations.idiomatic: During the time of Emperor Xiaohui and Empress Dowager Gao, since the realm had only just been settled, they again relaxed the laws on merchants, yet the sons and grandsons of the marketplace still could not serve as officials or clerks.

context.previous: 天下已平，高祖乃令賈人不得衣絲乘車，重租稅以困辱之。
context.next: 量吏祿，度官用，以賦於民。

translations.chinese: 量吏祿，度官用，以賦於民。
translations.literal: Measured clerk salaries, estimated official expenses, to levy on people.
translations.idiomatic: They measured clerk salaries and estimated official expenses, then levied them on the people.

context.previous: 孝惠、高后時，為天下初定，復弛商賈之律，然市井之子孫亦不得仕宦為吏。
context.next: 而山川園池市井租稅之入，自天子以至于封君湯沐邑，皆各為私奉養焉，不領於天下之經費。

translations.chinese: 而山川園池市井租稅之入，自天子以至于封君湯沐邑，皆各為私奉養焉，不領於天下之經費。
translations.literal: And mountains rivers parks ponds marketplace tax incomes, from Son of Heaven down to sealed lords hot bath towns, all each for private support, not included in world regular expenses.
translations.idiomatic: And the revenues from mountains, rivers, parks, ponds, and marketplaces, from the Son of Heaven down to the enfeoffed lords and their hot-spring estates, were all reserved for private support and not counted in the realm’s ordinary expenses.

context.previous: 量吏祿，度官用，以賦於民。
context.next: 漕轉山東粟，以給中都官，歲不過數十萬石。

translations.chinese: 漕轉山東粟，以給中都官，歲不過數十萬石。
translations.literal: Transported transferred Shan Dong grain, to supply central capital officials, year not over several ten thousand shi.
translations.idiomatic: Grain from Shandong was transported to supply the central offices, and the yearly total did not exceed several hundred thousand shi.

context.previous: 而山川園池市井租稅之入，自天子以至于封君湯沐邑，皆各為私奉養焉，不領於天下之經費。

translations.chinese: 至孝文時，莢錢益多，輕，乃更鑄四銖錢，其文為「半兩」，令民縱得自鑄錢。
translations.literal: To Xiao Wen time, leather money increasingly many, light, then moreover cast four zhu money, its inscription 'half liang', ordered people freely could self cast money.
translations.idiomatic: By the time of Emperor Xiaowen, the leather coins had become more numerous and light, so they cast new four-zhu coins bearing the inscription “half liang,” and allowed the people to cast coins freely.

context.next: 故吳諸侯也，以即山鑄錢，富埒天子，其後卒以叛逆。

translations.chinese: 故吳諸侯也，以即山鑄錢，富埒天子，其後卒以叛逆。
translations.literal: Therefore Wu feudal lord, by near mountain cast money, rich equal Son of Heaven, his after finally with rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore, the feudal lord of Wu cast coins near the mountains, became as rich as the Son of Heaven, and later finally rebelled.

context.previous: 至孝文時，莢錢益多，輕，乃更鑄四銖錢，其文為「半兩」，令民縱得自鑄錢。
context.next: 鄧通，大夫也，以鑄錢財過王者。

translations.chinese: 鄧通，大夫也，以鑄錢財過王者。
translations.literal: Deng Tong, grand master, with casting money wealth exceeded kings.
translations.idiomatic: Deng Tong, a grand master, grew richer than kings by casting money.

context.previous: 故吳諸侯也，以即山鑄錢，富埒天子，其後卒以叛逆。
context.next: 故吳、鄧氏錢布天下，而鑄錢之禁生焉。

translations.chinese: 故吳、鄧氏錢布天下，而鑄錢之禁生焉。
translations.literal: Therefore Wu, Deng clan money spread world, and casting money prohibition born there.
translations.idiomatic: Thus the coinage of Wu and the Deng clan spread throughout the realm, and the prohibition on casting money arose from it.

context.previous: 鄧通，大夫也，以鑄錢財過王者。

translations.chinese: 匈奴數侵盜北邊，屯戍者多，邊粟不足給食當食者。
translations.literal: Xiongnu frequently invaded robbed north border, garrisoned defended many, border grain insufficient supply food should eat ones.
translations.idiomatic: The Xiongnu frequently invaded and robbed the northern border, and those who garrisoned and defended were many, so border grain was insufficient to supply food to those who should eat.

context.next: 於是募民能輸及轉粟於邊者拜爵，爵得至大庶長。

translations.chinese: 於是募民能輸及轉粟於邊者拜爵，爵得至大庶長。
translations.literal: Therefore recruited people could transport and transfer grain to border ones granted nobility rank, rank could reach great commoner chief.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore, they recruited people who could transport and transfer grain to the border and granted them nobility ranks, and the ranks could reach great commoner chief.

context.previous: 匈奴數侵盜北邊，屯戍者多，邊粟不足給食當食者。

translations.chinese: 孝景時，上郡以西旱，亦復修賣爵令，而賤其價以招民；
translations.literal: Xiao Jing time, Shang Jun west drought, also again repaired sell nobility rank command, and cheapened its price to attract people;
translations.idiomatic: During the time of Emperor Xiaojing, when there was a drought west of Shangjun, they also again repaired the order to sell nobility ranks, and cheapened their prices to attract people;

context.next: 及徒復作，得輸粟縣官以除罪。

translations.chinese: 及徒復作，得輸粟縣官以除罪。
translations.literal: And convict labor again worked, got transport grain county officials to remove crime.
translations.idiomatic: And those who did convict labor again could transport grain to the county officials to remove their crimes.

context.previous: 孝景時，上郡以西旱，亦復修賣爵令，而賤其價以招民；
context.next: 益造苑馬以廣用，而宮室列觀輿馬益增修矣。

translations.chinese: 益造苑馬以廣用，而宮室列觀輿馬益增修矣。
translations.literal: Moreover made garden horses to broaden use, and palace rooms arranged towers carriages horses moreover increased repaired.
translations.idiomatic: They further made garden horses to broaden their use, and the palace rooms, arranged towers, carriages, and horses were increasingly added and repaired.

context.previous: 及徒復作，得輸粟縣官以除罪。

translations.chinese: 至今上即位數歲，漢興七十餘年之閒，國家無事，非遇水旱之災，民則人給家足，都鄙廩庾皆滿，而府庫餘貨財。
translations.literal: To now emperor ascended throne several years, Han rise seventy more years between, nation no affairs, not encounter water drought disasters, people then person supplied house sufficient, cities towns granaries all full, and treasuries surplus goods wealth.
translations.idiomatic: By the time the present emperor had been on the throne for several years, in the more than seventy years since Han rose, the nation had no affairs. When they did not encounter water or drought disasters, the people then had each person supplied and each house sufficient, the granaries of cities and towns were all full, and the treasuries had surplus goods and wealth.

context.next: 京師之錢累巨萬，貫朽而不可校。

translations.chinese: 京師之錢累巨萬，貫朽而不可校。
translations.literal: Capital money accumulated huge ten thousand, strings rotted and could not be counted.
translations.idiomatic: The money in the capital accumulated in huge amounts of ten thousands, and the strings rotted and could not be counted.

context.previous: 至今上即位數歲，漢興七十餘年之閒，國家無事，非遇水旱之災，民則人給家足，都鄙廩庾皆滿，而府庫餘貨財。
context.next: 太倉之粟陳陳相因，充溢露積於外，至腐敗不可食。

translations.chinese: 太倉之粟陳陳相因，充溢露積於外，至腐敗不可食。
translations.literal: Great granary grain old old mutually followed, full overflowed exposed piled outside, to rotten could not be eaten.
translations.idiomatic: The grain in the great granary, old grain following old grain, was full and overflowed, exposed and piled outside, until it rotted and could not be eaten.

context.previous: 京師之錢累巨萬，貫朽而不可校。
context.next: 眾庶街巷有馬，阡陌之閒成群，而乘字牝者儐而不得聚會。

translations.chinese: 眾庶街巷有馬，阡陌之閒成群，而乘字牝者儐而不得聚會。
translations.literal: Masses streets alleys had horses, paths crossroads between formed groups, and riding marked mares guide and could not gather meet.
translations.idiomatic: The masses in streets and alleys had horses, and between the paths and crossroads they formed groups, and those who rode marked mares were excluded and could not gather for meetings.

context.previous: 太倉之粟陳陳相因，充溢露積於外，至腐敗不可食。
context.next: 守閭閻者食粱肉，為吏者長子孫，居官者以為姓號。

translations.chinese: 守閭閻者食粱肉，為吏者長子孫，居官者以為姓號。
translations.literal: Guarded alley gates ate fine grain meat, served as clerks extended sons grandsons, resided as officials took as surname appellation.
translations.idiomatic: Those who guarded the alley gates ate fine grain and meat, those who served as clerks extended their sons and grandsons, and those who resided as officials took it as their surname and appellation.

context.previous: 眾庶街巷有馬，阡陌之閒成群，而乘字牝者儐而不得聚會。
context.next: 故人人自愛而重犯法，先行義而後絀恥辱焉。

translations.chinese: 故人人自愛而重犯法，先行義而後絀恥辱焉。
translations.literal: Therefore each person self loved and valued not violate law, first practiced righteousness then shrank from shame humiliation.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore, each person loved themselves and valued not violating the law, first practiced righteousness, and then shrank from shame and humiliation.

context.previous: 守閭閻者食粱肉，為吏者長子孫，居官者以為姓號。
context.next: 當此之時，網疏而民富，役財驕溢，或至兼并豪黨之徒，以武斷於鄉曲。

translations.chinese: 當此之時，網疏而民富，役財驕溢，或至兼并豪黨之徒，以武斷於鄉曲。
translations.literal: When this time, net loose and people rich, corvee wealth arrogant overflowing, or to annexed merged powerful faction followers, with military decided in rural areas.
translations.idiomatic: At this time, the net was loose and the people were rich. They used their wealth arrogantly and overflowingly, and some even annexed and merged with powerful faction followers, using military force to decide matters in rural areas.

context.previous: 故人人自愛而重犯法，先行義而後絀恥辱焉。
context.next: 宗室有土公卿大夫以下，爭于奢侈，室廬輿服僭于上，無限度。

translations.chinese: 宗室有土公卿大夫以下，爭于奢侈，室廬輿服僭于上，無限度。
translations.literal: Imperial clan had land dukes ministers grand masters below, contended in luxury, rooms houses carriages clothing usurped superiors, no limits.
translations.idiomatic: The imperial clan, those with land, dukes, ministers, and grand masters and below, contended in luxury, and their rooms, houses, carriages, and clothing usurped those of their superiors, with no limits.

context.previous: 當此之時，網疏而民富，役財驕溢，或至兼并豪黨之徒，以武斷於鄉曲。
context.next: 物盛而衰，固其變也。

translations.chinese: 物盛而衰，固其變也。
translations.literal: Things flourish then decline, certainly their change.
translations.idiomatic: When things flourish, they then decline; this is certainly their change.

context.previous: 宗室有土公卿大夫以下，爭于奢侈，室廬輿服僭于上，無限度。

translations.chinese: 自是之後，嚴助、朱買臣等招來東甌，事兩越，江淮之閒蕭然煩費矣。
translations.literal: From this after, Yan Zhu, Zhu Mai Chen etc. summoned came Dong Ou, managed two Yue, Jiang Huai between desolate troublesome costly.
translations.idiomatic: After this, Yan Zhu, Zhu Maichen, and others summoned and came to Dong'ou, managed the two Yue, and between the Jiang and Huai it became desolate, troublesome, and costly.

context.next: 唐蒙、司馬相如開路西南夷，鑿山通道千餘里，以廣巴蜀，巴蜀之民罷焉。

translations.chinese: 唐蒙、司馬相如開路西南夷，鑿山通道千餘里，以廣巴蜀，巴蜀之民罷焉。
translations.literal: Tang Meng, Sima Xiang Ru opened road southwest barbarians, chiseled mountain opened path thousand more li, to broaden Ba Shu, Ba Shu people exhausted there.
translations.idiomatic: Tang Meng and Sima Xiangru opened roads to the southwest barbarians, chiseled mountains and opened paths for more than a thousand li, to broaden Bashu, and the people of Bashu were exhausted by this.

context.previous: 自是之後，嚴助、朱買臣等招來東甌，事兩越，江淮之閒蕭然煩費矣。
context.next: 彭吳賈滅朝鮮，置滄海之郡，則燕齊之閒靡然發動。

translations.chinese: 彭吳賈滅朝鮮，置滄海之郡，則燕齊之閒靡然發動。
translations.literal: Peng Wu Jia extinguished Joseon, established vast sea commandery, then Yan Qi between dissipated moved.
translations.idiomatic: Peng Wujia extinguished Joseon and established the Canghai commandery, and then between Yan and Qi it dissipated and moved.

context.previous: 唐蒙、司馬相如開路西南夷，鑿山通道千餘里，以廣巴蜀，巴蜀之民罷焉。
context.next: 及王恢設謀馬邑，匈奴絕和親，侵擾北邊，兵連而不解，天下苦其勞，而干戈日滋。

translations.chinese: 及王恢設謀馬邑，匈奴絕和親，侵擾北邊，兵連而不解，天下苦其勞，而干戈日滋。
translations.literal: And Wang Hui set strategy Mai Yi, Xiongnu cut off peace marriage, invaded disturbed north border, wars connected not resolved, world suffered its labor, and weapons daily increased.
translations.idiomatic: And when Wang Hui set his strategy at Mayi, the Xiongnu cut off the peace marriage, invaded and disturbed the northern border, wars were connected and not resolved, the world suffered from its labor, and weapons daily increased.

context.previous: 彭吳賈滅朝鮮，置滄海之郡，則燕齊之閒靡然發動。
context.next: 行者齎，居者送，中外騷擾而相奉，百姓抏獘以巧法，財賂衰秏而不贍。

translations.chinese: 行者齎，居者送，中外騷擾而相奉，百姓抏獘以巧法，財賂衰秏而不贍。
translations.literal: Travelers carried provisions, residents sent, inside outside disturbed mutually supplied, hundred surnames constrained exhausted with skillful laws, wealth bribes declined expended not sufficient.
translations.idiomatic: Travelers carried provisions, residents supplied them, and the inner and outer regions were thrown into mutual disturbance. The common people were worn down by shrewd regulations, wealth and bribes shrank away, and still they were not enough.

context.previous: 及王恢設謀馬邑，匈奴絕和親，侵擾北邊，兵連而不解，天下苦其勞，而干戈日滋。
context.next: 入物者補官，出貨者除罪，選舉陵遲，廉恥相冒，武力進用，法嚴令具。

translations.chinese: 入物者補官，出貨者除罪，選舉陵遲，廉恥相冒，武力進用，法嚴令具。
translations.literal: Entered goods ones filled offices, exported goods ones removed crime, selections declined, integrity shame mutually deceived, martial force advanced used, laws strict commands complete.
translations.idiomatic: Those who brought in goods got offices, and those who exported goods were pardoned. Appointments declined, integrity and shame were trampled underfoot, military power advanced, and the laws were harsh while the commands were complete.

context.previous: 行者齎，居者送，中外騷擾而相奉，百姓抏獘以巧法，財賂衰秏而不贍。
context.next: 興利之臣自此始也。

translations.chinese: 興利之臣自此始也。
translations.literal: Arouse benefit ministers from this began also.
translations.idiomatic: The ministers who promoted profit began from this point.

context.previous: 入物者補官，出貨者除罪，選舉陵遲，廉恥相冒，武力進用，法嚴令具。

translations.chinese: 其後漢將歲以數萬騎出擊胡，及車騎將軍衛青取匈奴河南地，筑朔方。
translations.literal: Its after Han generals yearly with several ten thousand cavalry went out attacked Hu, and chariot cavalry general Wei Qing took Xiongnu Yellow River south land, built Shuo Fang.
translations.idiomatic: Afterward Han generals each year led tens of thousands of cavalry to attack the Hu, and the General of Chariots and Cavalry, Wei Qing, took the Xiongnu lands south of the Yellow River and built Shuofang.

context.next: 當是時，漢通西南夷道，作者數萬人，千里負擔饋糧，率十餘鐘致一石，散幣於邛僰以集之。

translations.chinese: 當是時，漢通西南夷道，作者數萬人，千里負擔饋糧，率十餘鐘致一石，散幣於邛僰以集之。
translations.literal: When this time, Han opened southwest barbarians road, workers several ten thousand, thousand li carried loads fed grain, rate ten more zhong delivered one shi, scattered coins at Qiong Bo to gather it.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Han opened roads to the southwestern barbarians, employing tens of thousands of workers. For a thousand li, they carried loads and fed grain, at a rate of more than ten zhong to deliver one shi, and scattered coins at Qiong and Bo to gather laborers.

context.previous: 其後漢將歲以數萬騎出擊胡，及車騎將軍衛青取匈奴河南地，筑朔方。
context.next: 數歲道不通，蠻夷因以數攻，吏發兵誅之。

translations.chinese: 數歲道不通，蠻夷因以數攻，吏發兵誅之。
translations.literal: Several years road not connected, barbarian barbarians therefore frequently attacked, clerks raised troops executed them.
translations.idiomatic: After several years the road remained unopened, so the barbarians repeatedly attacked, and the officials raised troops and executed them.

context.previous: 當是時，漢通西南夷道，作者數萬人，千里負擔饋糧，率十餘鐘致一石，散幣於邛僰以集之。
context.next: 悉巴蜀租賦不足以更之，乃募豪民田南夷，入粟縣官，而內受錢於都內。

translations.chinese: 悉巴蜀租賦不足以更之，乃募豪民田南夷，入粟縣官，而內受錢於都內。
translations.literal: All Ba Shu rents taxes insufficient to change it, then recruited rich people farmed south barbarians, entered grain county officials, and internally received money at capital inside.
translations.idiomatic: Even all the taxes of Bashu were insufficient for the task, so wealthy men were recruited to farm among the southern tribes; they turned in grain to the county officials and received cash in the capital.

context.previous: 數歲道不通，蠻夷因以數攻，吏發兵誅之。
context.next: 東至滄海之郡，人徒之費擬於南夷。

translations.chinese: 東至滄海之郡，人徒之費擬於南夷。
translations.literal: East to vast sea commandery, people troops expenses comparable to south barbarians.
translations.idiomatic: To the east, as far as Canghai Commandery, the expenses in manpower and transport were comparable to those among the southern tribes.

context.previous: 悉巴蜀租賦不足以更之，乃募豪民田南夷，入粟縣官，而內受錢於都內。
context.next: 又興十萬餘人筑衛朔方，轉漕甚遼遠，自山東咸被其勞，費數十百巨萬，府庫益虛。

translations.idiomatic: That year there was a small drought, and the emperor ordered officials to seek rain. Bu Shi said: 'County officials should only eat rents and wear taxes, but now Hongyang makes clerks sit in markets and arranged shops, peddling goods and seeking profit.

translations.literal: Cook Hong Yang, heaven then rain.'
translations.idiomatic: Cook Hongyang, and heaven will then rain.'

translations.literal: Grand Historian said: farming commerce artisans exchange roads connected, and turtle shells cowries gold money knives cloth currencies arose there.
translations.idiomatic: The Grand Historian said: When the roads of exchange for farming, commerce, and artisans were connected, the currencies of turtle shells, cowries, gold, money, knives, and cloth arose.

translations.chinese: 所從來久遠，自高辛氏之前尚矣，靡得而記云。
translations.literal: What came from long distant, from Gao Xin clan before still was, could not be recorded.
translations.idiomatic: What it came from was long and distant, and from before the Gaoxin clan it still was, but it could not be recorded.

translations.literal: Therefore writings spoke Tang Yu time, poems described Yin Zhou age, peaceful then grew schools, first fundamentals reduced ends, with rites righteousness guarded against profits;
translations.idiomatic: Therefore, the writings spoke of the time of Tang and Yu, and the poems described the age of Yin and Zhou. When peaceful, they grew schools, put fundamentals first and reduced ends, and with rites and righteousness guarded against profits;

translations.literal: Affairs changed many troubles and also reversed this.
translations.idiomatic: When affairs changed and had many troubles, they also reversed this.

context.next: 是以物盛則衰，時極而轉，一質一文，終始之變也。

translations.literal: Therefore things flourish then decline, time extreme then turn, one solid one pattern, beginning end change also.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore, when things flourish, they then decline. When time reaches an extreme, it then turns. One solid, one pattern—this is the change of beginning and end.

translations.literal: Yu tribute nine provinces, each according to their land suitable, people more less and paid duties there.
translations.idiomatic: In Yu's tribute, the nine provinces, each according to what was suitable for their land, and whether their people were more or less, paid duties.

context.previous: 是以物盛則衰，時極而轉，一質一文，終始之變也。

translations.literal: Tang Wu inherited exhaustion easily changed, made people not weary, each earnestly so governed, but gradually declined weakened.
translations.idiomatic: Tang and Wu inherited exhaustion and easily changed, making the people not weary. Each earnestly governed in this way, but they gradually declined and weakened.

translations.literal: Qi Huan duke used Guan Zhong strategy, connected light heavy power, cornered mountain sea industries, to make audience feudal lords, used small small Qi displayed became hegemon name.
translations.idiomatic: Duke Huan of Qi used Guan Zhong's strategy, connected the power of light and heavy, cornered the industries of mountains and seas, and made audiences with the feudal lords. Using the small Qi, he displayed and became a hegemon name.

translations.literal: Wei used Li Ke, exhausted land strength, became strong ruler.
translations.idiomatic: Wei used Li Ke, exhausted the land's strength, and became a strong ruler.

translations.literal: From this after, world contended in Warring States, valued deceit force but cheapened benevolence righteousness, first rich had then afterward yielded.
translations.idiomatic: From this time afterward, the world contended in the Warring States, valued deceit and force but cheapened benevolence and righteousness, and put wealth first and then afterward yielded.

translations.literal: Therefore commoners rich ones or accumulated huge ten thousand, but poor ones or not satisfied with bran husks;
translations.idiomatic: Therefore, the rich among commoners sometimes accumulated huge ten thousands, but the poor ones sometimes were not satisfied with bran and husks;

translations.literal: Had states strong ones or annexed groups small to serve feudal lords, but weak states or cut sacrifices extinguished generations.
translations.idiomatic: Those who had strong states sometimes annexed groups of small ones to serve the feudal lords, but weak states sometimes cut sacrifices and extinguished generations.

translations.literal: To arrived at Qin, finally united within seas.
translations.idiomatic: Until they arrived at Qin, which finally united what was within the seas.

translations.literal: Yu Xia currencies, gold as three kinds, or yellow, or white, or red;
translations.idiomatic: In the currencies of Yu and Xia, gold was of three kinds: either yellow, or white, or red;

context.previous: 以至於秦，卒并海內。

translations.idiomatic: or coins, or cloth, or knives, or turtle shells and cowries.

translations.literal: And to Qin, unifying one state currencies as (three) [two] grades, yellow gold with yi named, as upper currency;
translations.idiomatic: And when they reached Qin, unifying one state's currencies as (three) [two] grades, yellow gold was named with yi and was the upper currency;

translations.literal: Copper coins inscription said half liang, heavy like its writing, as lower currency.
translations.idiomatic: Copper coins had the inscription 'half liang', weighed like their writing, and were the lower currency.

translations.literal: And pearls jade, turtle shells cowries, silver tin kind as vessel decorations treasure stores, not as currency.
translations.idiomatic: And pearls, jade, turtle shells, cowries, silver, and tin and their kind were used as vessel decorations and treasure stores, but they were not used as the currency.

translations.literal: Yet each followed time and light heavy no constant.
translations.idiomatic: Yet each followed the time, and light and heavy had no constant.

translations.idiomatic: Therefore, externally they repelled the barbarian Di, and internally they aroused merit works. The scholars within the seas, with strength, farmed but had insufficient grain and food, and women spun and wove but had insufficient clothes.

translations.literal: Ancient ones often exhausted world resources wealth to support their superiors, still self considered insufficient also.
translations.idiomatic: The ancients often exhausted the world's resources and wealth to support their superiors, and still considered themselves insufficient.

translations.literal: No different therefore speak, affairs situations flow, mutually stimulated made so, why sufficient strange there.
translations.idiomatic: There is no different reason to speak of it. The flow of affairs and situations, mutually stimulating, made it so. Why is this sufficient to be strange?
